en-GB.name: Nightwatch: Clear Sky Alerts
en-GB.subtitle: Astrophotography night planner
en-GB.promotional_text: Know whether tonight is worth setting up: the sky score, the clear window and the targets that suit your telescope, on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.
en-GB.description:
Nightwatch sits in your menu bar and watches the weather for you. When tonight looks clear for long enough, it sends a heads-up before sunset, then a nudge just before the clear spell begins. If the forecast turns, it tells you.

Open it to see a sky score, the clear window, cloud by hour, darkness, the Moon, seeing, wind, dew risk and transparency, and the targets that suit your telescope's field of view tonight.

• Two forecasts compared: Apple Weather, with Open-Meteo as a second opinion, and 7Timer for seeing
• A warning when rain is forecast after the clear window, for a telescope left running outside
• A warning when wildfire smoke or haze will dim a clear night
• Targets chosen for your field of view, with presets for popular smart telescopes and cameras
• A colour sky-survey picture of each of 1,948 targets, downloaded once (about 18 MB)
• Your own horizon: mark the houses, trees or hills that block your sky, or measure them from a phone photo, and Nightwatch picks targets that clear them
• "How to shoot this" on every target: filter, exposure and frames for your telescope
• Tonight's plan: your favourites in the order they peak
• The next run of moonless nights, worked out for your site
• Darker skies nearby, scored for tonight against home
• Aurora alerts for your site, wherever you observe from
• Tonight's events: the Moon passing in front of a star, comets and the space station
• Spotlight and Shortcuts actions, so a shortcut can act on tonight's sky
• A Text size setting, and small, medium and large desktop widgets

No accounts, no advertising and no tracking. Nightwatch is open source.
